subject: ZenWell SOC 2 + security follow-up & next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@zenwell.com>, Derek Chu <derek.chu@zenwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: ZenWell SOC 2 + security follow-up & next steps

Hi Samantha / Derek —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and so the security team has the artifacts they asked for. Please reply with any corrections.

Top pain points & goals you mentioned:
- Need verifiable SOC 2 Type II evidence and pen test summaries for vendor risk review
- Retention policy and audit log access for regulatory/compliance team (HIPAA-adjacent controls)
- Data residency + DPA terms (standard + a few custom clauses)
- Timeline for procurement — security review in ~3 weeks; legal requested DPA and evidence ASAP

What we’ll provide (next steps):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — ETA: EOD Tue, 2027-04-27 (PDF link will be sent)
2) Pen test summary & remediation status — attached summary + details to follow if you need full report (we'll coordinate an NDA)
3) Audit logs sample & retention policy doc — sample CSV and retention table (we can provide longer history on dedicated instances)
4) Draft DPA for your legal team to review — we’ll share a DocuSign-ready copy and can iterate on a couple custom clauses you flagged
5) Security deep-dive call (optional) — propose Wed 2027-04-28 10:00am PT or Thu 2027-04-29 9:00am PT; agenda: logging/retention, access controls, evidence handoff, timelines

Action items for ZenWell:
- Confirm which stakeholders should be on the security deep-dive (security, legal, procurement)
- Share any additional evidence requests (specific log retention windows, SIEM integration details, or regulatory references)

We’ve attached the SOC 2 report and pen test summary draft to this thread and included a sample of an audit log export. Marissa and Rishi are looped in to help on the DPA and technical artifacts.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Security Lead, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (redacted), redwood-pen-test-summary-2026.pdf, audit-logs-sample.csv

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@zenwell.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Derek Chu <derek.chu@zenwell.com>, ZenWell Security <security@zenwell.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenWell SOC 2 + security follow-up & next steps

Thanks Neha — really helpful summary. A few follow-ups from our side:

1) Procurement timeline: security review kickoff is Tues 2027-05-11, we need vendor evidence by 2027-05-04 to circulate to our risk committee.
2) Can you confirm whether audit logs include user identity (email) and full request/response bodies or just metadata? We need to know for our retention mapping.
3) For pen test evidence — do you provide full reports under NDA or only executive summaries? Our security team prefers full reports under NDA.
4) DPA: we’ll review your draft. A couple of our legal asks are data-subject rights flow and a clause on subprocessor notification windows.

Samantha
Head of Procurement, ZenWell
samantha@zenwell.com | +1 (617) 555-3421

Neha / Rishi — quick internal note with proposed artifact owners and timelines (forwarding thread):

Summary of asks from ZenWell: SOC2 evidence by 2027-04-27, pen test full report under NDA, audit log schema/retention detail, DPA negotiation points. Procurement needs everything to circulate by 2027-05-04.

Proposed owners / delivery plan:
- SOC2 PDF (redacted): Marissa to attach and send (done) — file: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf
- Pen test: Security ops (Rishi) to coordinate NDA and provide full report under NDA; send exec summary now (redwood-pen-test-summary-2026.pdf)
- Audit logs sample & schema: Rishi to pull sample CSV and scrub PII; file: audit-logs-sample.csv
- DPA draft: Neha to prepare DocuSign package and initial draft DPA (DPA_Redwood_Draft_zenwell.docx). Neha to include subprocessor list and notification windows.
- Scheduling: Neha to propose times and send calendar invite.

Deadlines to meet procurement date: aim to have SOC2 PDF + pen test exec summary + audit sample + DPA draft to ZenWell by Tue 2027-04-27 COB PDT so they can circulate by 2027-05-04. If any delays, flag immediately.

Marissa
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
